record.field: Concert Halls - Set up views, menus and dynamic snippet filters

website = env.ref('concert_halls.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ # Presets 'website.footer_custom', 'website.header_search_box', 'website.header_text_element', 'website.template_footer_mega', 'website.template_footer_minimalist', 'website_event.opt_events_list_columns', # Default static pages, replaced by the custom ones 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ]
to_activate = [ # Presets 'website.footer_no_copyright', 'website.header_call_to_action', 'website.template_footer_mega_columns', 'website.template_footer_slideout', # Header. The alignment variant inherits the base template, so the base # has to stay active too - activating only the variant renders no header # at all (and therefore no menu). 'website.template_header_default', 'website.template_header_default_align_center', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
for xml_id in to_deactivate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)] top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1)
# Default menu items to remove menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/shop', '/appointment'])]).unlink()
def set_menu(url, name, sequence): """Rename/reorder the menu for `url`, creating it when no module provides it.
website.main_menu only ships Home since 19.4 (Contact us was dropped), and /event comes from website_event.menu_events - both are copied onto the new website by website._bootstrap_homepage(). So some of these already exist and must not be duplicated, while others have to be created. """ menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', url)], limit=1) if menu: menu.write({'name': name, 'sequence': sequence}) else: menus.create({ 'name': name, 'url': url, 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id, 'sequence': sequence, })
set_menu('/', 'Home', 0) set_menu('/business', 'Business', 1) set_menu('/event', 'Shows', 2) set_menu('/contactus', 'Contact us', 3)
# Dynamic snippet filters are referenced by database id, which the export cannot # know, so the page arches carry __EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__<xmlid>__EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__ # markers instead. Every page view is loaded by now, so resolve them to real ids. MARK = '__EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__' for view in env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().search([('website_id', '=', website.id)]): arch = view.arch_db or '' if MARK not in arch: continue new_arch = arch while MARK in new_arch: start = new_arch.index(MARK) end = new_arch.index(MARK, start + len(MARK)) + len(MARK) xmlid = new_arch[start + len(MARK):end - len(MARK)] try: resolved = str(env.ref(xmlid).id) except ValueError: resolved = '0' new_arch = new_arch[:start] + resolved + new_arch[end:] view.write({'arch_db': new_arch})
